name: revbudget
description: Personal budget tracker that turns Revolut push notifications into classified transactions, with a Telegram bot and a Vue dashboard.

scripts.dev: bun run dev:server & bun run dev:dashboard
scripts.build: bun run --cwd dashboard build && bun build server/src/index.ts --target=bun --outdir=dist
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd shared typecheck && bun run --cwd server typecheck && bun run --cwd dashboard typecheck
